Elena Morris: hi folks, I'm starting Monday — quick Q: where are architecture decision records and security review templates in Notion? need view + edit on the ADR template and the security-assessment template. who owns these?

Marcus Allen: welcome Elena! ADRs live under Engineering > Architecture > ADRs. security templates are under Security > Templates > Reviews. owners are listed at the top of each page (eng-arch and security).

Sana Iqbal: if you need edit access fast, ping the owner or file the docs-perms form: https://redwood.in/forms/docs-perms (select "edit", paste page URLs). For ADRs: duplicate the ADR template before editing.

Elena Morris: i can see the folders but ADR pages are read-only. if i duplicate, will reviewers still be able to find it?

Marcus Allen: yes — best practice: Duplicate -> Move to Team Space -> Add reviewers (security@redwood + eng-arch). Use the title prefix "ADR - <short title> - EM" so reviewers can filter.

docs-ops: Ticket DOCS-7732 created for Elena Morris requesting edit on "ADR template" and "security-assessment template". Owner: Marcus Allen. ETA: 1 business day.

Sana Iqbal: also FYI some security templates are restricted for compliance reasons. if duplication is blocked, Marcus will triage and grant view then you can duplicate.

Elena Morris: thanks! filing the form now. can someone add me as a reviewer on the ADRs list so it's discoverable?

Marcus Allen: added you to the "ADR review" group and gave you viewer on the ADR index. once docs-ops grants edit you'll be set. ping me for a quick walkthrough of the ADR template.

notion-bot: DOCS-7732 updated: Marcus Allen assigned. Status: pending.

Elena Morris: perfect — appreciate the help :raised_hands: will start drafting an ADR this afternoon.
